subject: Renewal billing reconciliation, invoice split request and EU VAT residency question
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@skyward.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@skyward.ai
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal billing — draft charges + VAT residency question

Hi Diego,

Hope you’re well. We’re working through the renewal paperwork for Skyward Labs (SOW RD-2025-77) and have a couple of asks before we route payment: 

- Can you confirm the final true-up amount for usage between 2025-11-01 and 2026-04-30? The number in the renewal doc appears to be a consolidated estimate but our AP needs line-item split (base renewal vs true-up).
- We are EU-registered (Italy) and need Redwood’s VAT treatment for this renewal. Do you invoice with VAT charged, or do we need to self-assess under the reverse-charge mechanism? If you need our VAT registration docs, let us know where to upload.

I’ve attached the draft renewal invoice we received from sales for reference.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can push PO and payment.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Finance Lead, Skyward Labs
Elena.rossi@skyward.ai
attachments: Proposed_Renewal_Invoice_v2.pdf (PDF, 132KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@skyward.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal billing — draft charges + VAT residency question

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice. Quick answers below, and I’ve looped in Marcus (finance) and Monica (account lead) to finalize the line items and VAT flow.

- True-up split: Our accounting team is finalizing the usage reconciliation today. Preliminary split is: base renewal $120,000, usage true-up $8,430. I will confirm the final cents-level amounts by EOD tomorrow.
- VAT: Redwood issues invoices from our UK entity for EU customers. In most cases for B2B EU customers with valid VAT IDs we apply 0% and the customer self-accounts under reverse-charge — but we need your VAT number and, for our records, a scanned VAT registration (VAT cert) or an EU VAT validation URL. Marcus — can you confirm the exact doc we need for Skyward?

Next steps: Marcus will send the finalized invoice files and a short guidance note for AP. Monica, can you confirm whether Skyward requested invoice split across two POs or a single PO referencing the split?

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal billing — draft charges + VAT residency question

Monica / Diego — forwarding draft and Elena's VAT question. I spoke with accounting — here’s what we’ll provide to AP: 

1) Finalized invoice set: two PDFs (i) Invoice_A — base renewal $120,000, (ii) Invoice_B — usage true-up $8,430. Both will include line-item breakdown and GL codes.
2) VAT evidence packet: we need (a) customer VAT number (for validation), (b) either a VAT certificate or the EU VIES validation URL, (c) billing contact name and PO reference. I’ve prepared a short spreadsheet template for the VAT residency data.
3) Payment instructions: bank wiring details + SEPA IBAN optional.

I’m attaching the VAT residency template (vat_residency_form_skyward.xlsx). Diego — if Skyward prefers we consolidate onto one invoice with PO-split lines, we can also emit a single invoice with two line groups and a staggered due date. Need Monica to confirm customer preference before I generate final PDF.

Attachments: vat_residency_form_skyward.xlsx

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 10:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal billing — draft charges + VAT residency question

Diego / Marcus — I just spoke with Elena on a quick call. Skyward prefers two documents: a single PO referencing both line-items (so AP can process as one payment) plus an attached split invoice set (Invoice_A/Invoice_B). They will provide the PO but want Redwood to indicate on each invoice which GL code to post to.

Action items I agreed to handle:
- Marcus: generate Invoice_A and Invoice_B with GL codes and include our recommended payment terms (Net 30) and wiring instructions.
- Diego: ask Elena to upload the VAT registration or paste the VIES URL into the VAT form.
- Marcus: include a short note on the invoice header that for EU B2B customers we apply reverse-charge; include our UK entity tax ID and billing address.

I’ll notify the customer once invoices are available so they can attach the PO.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@skyward.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@skyward.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 14:22:00 +02:00
